thresholdDerivation.population: 37 complete batches (185 runs) read from retained .lighthouseci artifacts. apps/web/perf/warm-hermetic-auth.cjs warms the authenticated route before collection, so the first-request compile of the production server is not measured.
thresholdDerivation.total-blocking-time: 1200 ms. Warm batch medians: mean 792.1 ms, sd 131.4 ms, max 1058.2 ms, so 1200 (just above mean+3sd) fails no clean batch and still fails a regression that adds about 400 ms of main-thread blocking. Re-derive if the warm median moves by more than about 20 percent.
thresholdDerivation.largest-contentful-paint: Reporting only. On this runner clean and regressed five-run batches overlap (a 500 ms server-render delay passed a 7800 ms median gate), so apps/web/perf/report-lcp.mjs prints all five values and summary statistics without failing the job. Do not restore an LCP gate without a runner whose clean and regressed distributions separate.
thresholdDerivation.resource-summary:script:size: 820000 bytes. Batch medians of script transferSize spanned 749508 to 770185 bytes (2.8 percent), and 820000 is 6.5 percent above the largest, tight enough to catch a real dependency or code-splitting regression.
thresholdDerivation.aggregation: Five runs with independent median aggregation for total-blocking-time and script size.
